name: Toyoake (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Toyoake city emblem in red: a stylised device of two facing curved strokes with two discs.
history: Municipal flag of Toyoake, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1966.

features.role: Toyoake city emblem — a stylised device of two facing curved strokes with two discs
